meta.description: Brand style rules for AI image generation — palette, typography, model hints per pillar, aspect ratios per platform, and provider-ready prompt scaffolding.

education.label: Education & Authority
model_hints: swing golf club mid-motion, TrackMan data overlay, split-screen technique analysis
indoor golf simulator, Johannesburg, TrackMan launch monitor readings, clean studio lighting
golf instructor demonstrating grip, side-by-side swing comparison, professional setting
negative_prompts: cluttered background, people in background, blurry, low quality, distorted text
outdated equipment, worn golf balls, unprofessional setting, blurry swing
watermark, signature, text overlay unless specified

composition.primary_subject: golfer mid-swing or instructor demonstrating technique
composition.background: clean indoor studio or driving range, Johannesburg cityscape subtly visible through window
composition.lighting: natural daylight from left, soft fill from right, accent spotlight on clubhead
composition.depth_of_field: shallow — subject sharp, background softly blurred

education.example_prompt_fragment: Split-screen golf swing analysis, TrackMan data overlay, indoor Johannesburg studio, professional photography, ShotByJHB aesthetic, F/2.8 shallow depth of field, 35mm prime lens

club-fitting.label: Club Fitting
model_hints: golf club fitting session, fitter with launch monitor screen, client holding new driver
TrackMan screen showing ball flight data, close-up of iron being fitted, precision setting
golf bag with custom fitted clubs, workshop aesthetic, precision tools in frame
negative_prompts: unprofessional workshop, messy environment, broken clubs, low quality
people not relevant to fitting, distracting logos, generic stock photo look
incorrect club sizes, bent shafts, damaged clubheads

composition.primary_subject: fitted golf club or fitting session with data screen
composition.background: Swing Shack fitting studio with TrackMan visible, clean precision aesthetic
composition.lighting: dramatic side lighting, slight lens flare from monitor glow, contrasty
composition.depth_of_field: medium — both club and fitting screen in focus

club-fitting.example_prompt_fragment: Golf club fitting session with TrackMan launch monitor, Johannesburg precision studio, professional product photography, ShotByJHB aesthetic, dramatic side lighting, 50mm portrait lens

community.label: Community
model_hints: group of golfers socialising at Swing Shack, warm Johannesburg evening light
golf community event, people laughing with clubs, outdoor course backdrop
golfer high-fiving instructor after lesson, celebration moment, authentic candid
negative_prompts: sad expressions, people looking at camera directly, posed group photo
crowded messy backgrounds, cigarette smoke, outdated facilities
people alone looking lonely, overly commercial, stock photo aesthetic

composition.primary_subject: people connecting over golf — genuine, candid-feeling moments
composition.background: Swing Shack venue or nearby Johannesburg golf course, warm evening golden hour
composition.lighting: golden hour warm light, natural and flattering, slight lens flare
composition.depth_of_field: shallow — subjects sharp, bokeh lights in background

community.example_prompt_fragment: Golf community social event, Johannesburg golden hour, genuine celebration moment, candid documentary photography, ShotByJHB aesthetic, warm color grading, 35mm street photography lens

events.label: Events & Offers
model_hints: Swing Shack event banner in foreground, Johannesburg skyline, professional event photography
golfer celebrating a win with new fitted clubs, premium offer framing
promotional display at Swing Shack, trackman data visible, exclusive offer visual
negative_prompts: outdated promotional materials, low-res graphics, clip art
empty venue, sad lonely atmosphere, wrong brand colors
other brand logos prominent, competitor branding, generic stock look

composition.primary_subject: event atmosphere or promotional offer with clear call-to-action
composition.background: Swing Shack event venue or Johannesburg skyline, professional event staging
composition.lighting: bright and energetic, event spotlights, high contrast for readability
composition.depth_of_field: medium to deep — offer text must be legible at all sizes

events.example_prompt_fragment: Golf event promotional photography, Swing Shack Johannesburg venue, bold composition, ShotByJHB aesthetic, professional event lighting, 24mm wide-angle lens, high contrast color grading

instagram.text_safety_zone: center 70% of frame — no critical text in outer 15%

tiktok.text_safety_zone: top 30% and bottom 25% — middle band is safest for text

twitter.text_safety_zone: bottom third — title and CTA, top 2/3 for visual

facebook.text_safety_zone: center — landscape framing with space for headline overlay

gmb.text_safety_zone: full frame — prefer no overlaid text, let the image speak

ideogram.name: Ideogram
ideogram.prompt_suffix: — shot by @swingshackjhb, ShotByJHB aesthetic, professional golf photography

dall-e.prompt_prefix: Professional golf photography, Swing Shack Johannesburg brand aesthetic.
dall-e.prompt_suffix: ShotByJHB style, high-end golf marketing photography.
dall-e.negative_hint: Do not include any text, logos, or watermarks.

midjourney.name: Midjourney
midjourney.negative_hint: --no text, watermark, signature, low quality, blurry

stable-diffusion.name: Stable Diffusion / ComfyUI
stable-diffusion.prompt_prefix: masterpiece, best quality, professional golf photography, Swing Shack Johannesburg aesthetic,
stable-diffusion.negative_hint: text, watermark, signature, low quality, blurry, deformed, bad anatomy
stable-diffusion.controlnet_hint: Use Canny or Depth controlnet for consistent golf poses

lighting_mood.primary: natural daylight with warm Johannesburg golden hour tones
lighting_mood.secondary: studio spotlight with soft fill for indoor equipment shots
lighting_mood.accent: subtle lens flare from monitor/display glow for tech-forward content

photojournalism_notes: Prefer authentic-feeling candids over posed shots
Always show emotion — celebration, focus, community joy
Include subtle Johannesburg urban context in outdoor shots
TrackMan/data screens should be readable but not dominating frame
Club detail shots benefit from dramatic side lighting
